about.ai: AI is part of how I work, not a side topic. I ship with Claude Code and agentic workflows every day, and my most recent build is a hybrid-search RAG assistant served over MCP.

projects.name: Virtual Garden
projects.tagline: A Chrome extension that grows a garden from your focus.
projects.serious: Time on sites you mark as productive grows a small garden on the page, and the rest makes it wilt. It's built with WXT (Manifest V3), TypeScript and Vitest, with CI on every PR. Four looks: zen, cosmic, ocean and pixel.
projects.joke: Doomscrolling wilts it. It has opinions.

projects.name: retrieval-tracer
projects.tagline: Retrieval, up close, in the browser.
projects.serious: Sentence embeddings (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) run in the browser through transformers.js, and you can see how cosine similarity is built up dimension by dimension. It's the groundwork for the chunking and hybrid-search steps that come next.
projects.joke: It agrees that a cat on a mat and a feline on a rug are related. Cautiously.

projects.name: chord-cycle-open
projects.tagline: A chord wheel you play with your hands.
projects.serious: You play it in the browser with a pointer, touch or a webcam. MediaPipe hand tracking picks the chord, opening your hand swells it, and Web Audio plays it. No plugins and no MIDI hardware.
projects.joke: Air guitar, except the chords are correct.

projects.name: desk-3d
projects.serious: A Blender-built scene running in react-three-fiber. It has GPU rain on the glass, AgX grading, an eye-height interior camera, a mobile tier, and a plain-HTML version for recruiters and search engines.
projects.joke: It has been raining here since the first commit.

stops.label: Laptop · 3D for the web
stops.title: 3D on the sites you already have
body: My goal is to bring 3D artwork into client websites: product scenes, interactive rooms, and small moments that make a page memorable, without hurting load time or accessibility.
This room is the training ground. It's modelled in Blender, exported as glTF, then lit and graded in react-three-fiber. It has a lighter mobile tier and a plain-HTML fallback.
If your site could use a third dimension, let's talk.
stops.joke: The laptop is rendering the room you're standing in. It's turtles all the way down, with lightmaps.

stops.label: Terrarium · Virtual Garden
stops.title: Virtual Garden
body: This garden grows from your focus. Time on sites you mark as productive grows it, and the rest makes it wilt.

The score is productive ÷ (productive + non-productive). Neutral sites don't dilute it, and it stays at 50 until there are five minutes of data. It's built with WXT and TypeScript, tested with Vitest, and runs CI on every PR.
stops.joke: It's low maintenance with high judgement.
